component.name: Blender MCP
component.summary: Blender integration through the Model Context Protocol

description.p: Blender MCP runs a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects Blender to MCP-compatible AI assistants, enabling prompt-assisted 3D modeling, scene creation and manipulation driven by an LLM.

Through the MCP connection, an assistant can inspect and modify a running Blender scene: creating and editing objects, applying materials, executing arbitrary Python inside Blender, and downloading assets from third-party sources such as Poly Haven and Sketchfab.
